# Kei Ikegami

Lecturer (tenured), Yokohama City University  
Email: ikegami.kei.pr [at] yokohama-cu.ac.jp  
Website: [keiikegami.github.io](https://keiikegami.github.io)

[Download PDF CV](/files/cv.pdf)

Economist working in empirical industrial organization, econometrics, and market design. My research combines Japanese platform, healthcare, and procurement data with structural estimation and counterfactual policy analysis.

## Academic Appointments

- **Yokohama City University**, Lecturer (tenured), April 2026–present
- **University of Tokyo**, Research Assistant Professor at UTMD, 2025–2026

## Education

- **PhD in Economics**, New York University, 2020–2025
- **MA in Economics**, The University of Tokyo, 2018–2020
- **BA in Economics**, The University of Tokyo, 2013–2018

## Research Fields

- Industrial Organization
- Econometrics
- Market Design
- Auctions and Matching
